note: Canteen (2020 pano hotspot 'Kantin'): long single-storey gable-roofed block north of Block C, between the round bed (W) and the east service road; beige horizontal siding with one brown band, red brick-tile plinth, dark-brown roof with boxed eaves, a glazed porch at the west gable.
